memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
  - Status: Stable, NYHA class II, weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cut-off 90 cm).
  - Plan: Continue sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, spironolactone 25 mg OD, furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD. Monitor weight weekly, reduce salt.
- Glaucoma
  - Status: IOP 22 mmHg OD, 21 mmHg OS, visual field full, optic disc cupping 0.4.
  - Plan: Continue timolol 0.5% eye drops BD, latanoprost 0.005% eye drops HS. Repeat IOP in 3 months.
Diet advice: Breakfast – low‑salt Indian breakfast with whole wheat roti and boiled egg; Lunch – vegetable dal with brown rice, limited oil; Dinner – light khichdi with curd.
Due: None
